quote: You can't use up creativity. The more you use, the more you have.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: The chief enemy of creativity is 'good' sense.
author: Pablo Picasso

quote: Creativity involves breaking out of established patterns in order to look at things in a different way.
author: Edward de Bono

quote: Curiosity about life in all of its aspects, I think, is still the secret of great creative people.
author: Leo Burnett

quote: An essential aspect of creativity is not being afraid to fail.
author: Edwin Land

quote: Creativity is seeing what everyone else has seen, and thinking what no one else has thought.
author: Albert Szent-Györgyi
